description: Running scripts/relaunch.sh or bundle.sh --install in a test kills and restarts the user's real Flick
resolution: Test with FLICK_INSTALL_DIR=<tmp> plus --no-restart, or stub pgrep/launchctl/open on PATH

description: bash 3.2 (and bash < 5.1) writes heredoc/here-string bodies to temp files, so secrets or canaries leak to disk; grep -r without -D skip can hang on FIFOs in /tmp.
resolution: Pass secrets through a pipe or <(printf ...); use grep -D skip (docs/local-llm/verify-private.sh).
